facts.text: Rachel made landfall in far northern Baja California the evening of Oct. 10 as a weakened tropical storm
SMN: Rachel entered Mexico early Oct. 11 about 40 km SSE of Ensenada with 95 km/h winds, 110 km/h gusts
At 21:00 Oct. 11 post-tropical Rachel was 65 km SW of Cabo San Quintin moving NNE at 57 km/h
NHC final advisory Oct. 11: Rachel dissipated over the southwestern U.S.
NHC advisory 56A tropical storm warnings for Baja California coasts
Baja California government forecast 60-80 km/h winds, gusts to 140 km/h, and opened shelters via DIF
SMN forecast 25-50 mm rain, gusts to 100 km/h, waves to 6 m, landslide and flood risk
Rachel prompted the second-ever tropical storm watch for California (San Diego County)
NHC: major coastal flooding with water levels up to 1.5 ft above predictions
Wikipedia: Rachel caused two deaths in Mexico from rain and flash flooding
No official Mexican fatality or damage figure located; 5 dead/5 missing tally is Wikipedia's
Oct. 11 SMN advisory: Hurricane Simon Category 4, 95 km west of Manzanillo, 240 km/h winds
Mexico death toll from Rachel, all in Ensenada, four minors (eight per Gen. Gallegos, later nine)
Four deaths had been reported as of Monday
Eighth victim was a 17-year-old boy (Luis Fernando Lopez) found in Lomas de Mendoza
Other seven dead: three minors (4, 13, 14), three women and a 51-year-old man
Five of the dead are members of the Burgos (Terán) family of Hermosillo, Sonora
Outstanding missing count unresolved: two per Gen. Gallegos, four per El País
10-year-old boy found alive; 32 civilians airlifted from Rancho Génesis
Six shelters active and more than 3,500 troops and personnel mobilized
Gov. Marina del Pilar Ávila says emergency remains active, warns Simon could reach Baja California Sunday
Simon now Category 1, semi-stationary off Jalisco, not expected to make landfall
Tropical Storm Trudy formed Tuesday and could become a major hurricane by Friday
At least 370 homes damaged in Ensenada and 258 in San Quintín
Ninth victim Rosa María Olivera Almazán, 44, found Wednesday in Maneadero
Rosalinda (Olivera) Almazán remains missing; age given as 23 or 24
Ensenada mayor Claudia Agatón Muñiz requested a disaster declaration
22 per cent of Ensenada lacks water after desalination plant flooded; crops and ~200 cattle lost
Olivera Almazán was swept away Saturday night in Lomas de Mendoza
Several outlets still report the earlier eight-death figure
Other identified dead include the Burgos Terán family, Valentín Lozano Gómez and Keila Azalea Sandria González
Óscar Ulloa, 40, and nephew Adrián Caro Villares, 12, missing in San Felipe
PAN senator told the Senate Oct. 13 the toll was five dead and seven missing

missed.text: Rachel formed Sept. 27 off Guerrero and peaked as a Category 3 hurricane
Flash flood warnings issued for Las Vegas and southwestern and central Utah
Remnants produced over 1 ft of snow in parts of Montana and flood watches in Utah
President Sheinbaum on Monday directed the armed forces to maintain vigilance and aid in the zone
No federal (SEDENA/Segob/Conagua) death-toll statement located; eight figure comes from the Second Military Zone commander and state officials
Earlier missing count of 13 has fallen with search-and-rescue recoveries
